expectations.text: The check command exits 0 (features.json has the three spec behaviours, all passes:false; todo.js not written)
Each feature names an exact command that checks it (e.g. node todo.js add "x" prints added: x)
expectations.evidence: Each of the four features in features.json has a concrete shell 'check' field, e.g. F1: `[ "$(node todo.js add 'alpha one')" = 'added: alpha one' ]`, and F4 checks `[ "$(node todo.js done 1)" = 'done: alpha one' ]`.

expectations.text: The proposed /goal condition is one measurable end state with the exact check, plus constraints or a turn bound, not a vague wish like 'everything works'
expectations.evidence: The condition says 'Done means this command ... exits 0 and prints "4/4 passing"', includes the full node runner command with a hash guard, and adds constraints ('do not edit any "check" field...', 'No force-push') plus a turn bound ('Stop after 30 turns even if not done').
